environment: Targeted repair on the documented single production deployment, followed by read-only validation.

checks.observation: Docker inspection confirmed alias livekit on the LiveKit voice-platform_private endpoint.

checks.name: API network isolation
checks.observation: The API remained attached only to voice-platform_private and voice-platform_telemetry-egress; it was not added to voice-platform_edge.

checks.name: API namespace DNS and authenticated RoomService preflight

LiveKit returned HTTP 200 and no matching dummy room. Runtime credential values and room inventory were not emitted.

checks.observation: At 2026-10-08T20:28:21Z, voice_platform_incident_last_successful was 1 for both livekit_list_rooms and livekit_probe.

checks.name: Authenticated end-user roster endpoint smoke
checks.observation: No authenticated browser session was supplied. The controlled RoomService preflight validates the dependency path but is not an end-user GET /api/v1/voice/rosters/events request.

checks.name: Signed release installation
checks.observation: GitHub Deploy production workflow completed successfully and installed the verified source revision. The deployment log confirms the private DNS and authenticated RoomService preflight passed.

checks.name: Post-deploy health and maintenance state
checks.observation: The running API reports the expected source revision; API-private and public health both returned HTTP 200; maintenance admission is inactive.

checks.name: Post-deploy LiveKit and roster metrics
checks.observation: After API restart, livekit_list_rooms and livekit_probe last-success gauges were 1; their successful operation counters were 37 and 5. The API reported 32 successful ListRooms calls and 47 successful roster snapshots, with no presence_room_list failure series present.

checks.name: Authenticated GET /api/v1/voice/rosters/events smoke
checks.observation: No authenticated browser session was supplied; the successful Go roster snapshots and dependency preflight do not prove a specific user-authenticated SSE response.

limitations: The original 503 has no request ID or timestamp, so it cannot be correlated as one historical request. The live DNS and authenticated RoomService dependency path now pass; a real authenticated roster endpoint smoke remains unverified.
